fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-11-22 (morning, 09:00): The complainant noticed that Rs. 4,50,000 had been withdrawn through multiple online transactions in a short interval. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100085 as the destination of the transfer. Nithin Thangaraj was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Mathan Balan, using the number 9000000084. Items referenced in the complaint: transaction records and a bank transaction reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Funds reportedly routed through a chain of accounts.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, transaction record, morning, receiving account, suspect, bank reference, witness
